explanation: Population of City E in 2001 was 500,000 and in 2011 was 600,000. Absolute increase = 600,000 - 500,000 = 100,000. Option A (50,000) incorrectly underestimates the growth.

question:
Study the table below showing the number of patients treated in five hospital departments over three years and answer the question.

Department | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Cardiology | 1200 | 1500 | 1800
Orthopedics | 900 | 1100 | 1300
Pediatrics | 1500 | 1600 | 2000
Neurology | 600 | 800 | 1000
General Medicine | 2500 | 2800 | 3200

Q. Which department recorded the highest total number of patients treated across the three years combined?
explanation: Total patients: Cardiology = 1200+1500+1800 = 4500; Orthopedics = 900+1100+1300 = 3300; Pediatrics = 1500+1600+2000 = 5100; Neurology = 600+800+1000 = 2400; General Medicine = 2500+2800+3200 = 8500. General Medicine has the highest total of 8500. Option B (Pediatrics) has a total of 5100.
question_hi:

न्यूरोलॉजी | 600 | 800 | 1000

explanation_hi: तीनों वर्षों का कुल योग करने पर सामान्य चिकित्सा (जनरल मेडिसिन) का कुल योग 8500 है जो सभी विभागों में सबसे अधिक है। विकल्प B (बाल रोग) का योग 5100 है।

question:

Q. Who secured the highest aggregate marks across all five subjects?
explanation: Aggregate marks: Student 1 = 70+80+75+85+90 = 400. Student 2 = 350. Student 3 = 85+90+95+80+85 = 435. Student 4 = 300. Student 5 = 90+85+80+95+90 = 450. Student 6 = 375. Student 5 has 450, which is the highest.
question_hi:

छात्र | Sub 1 | Sub 2 | Sub 3 | Sub 4 | Sub 5
Student 1 | 70 | 80 | 75 | 85 | 90
Student 2 | 60 | 65 | 70 | 75 | 80
Student 3 | 85 | 90 | 95 | 80 | 85
Student 4 | 50 | 55 | 60 | 65 | 70
Student 5 | 90 | 85 | 80 | 95 | 90
Student 6 | 75 | 70 | 65 | 80 | 85

प्र. सभी पाँच विषयों में कुल मिलाकर सबसे अधिक कुल अंक किसने प्राप्त किए?
explanation_hi: कुल अंक: Student 1 = 400, Student 2 = 350, Student 3 = 435, Student 4 = 300, Student 5 = 450, Student 6 = 375 है। Student 5 के 450 अंक हैं, जो सबसे अधिक हैं।
